title: Sync to iCloud with CKSyncEngine
description: Discover how CKSyncEngine can help you sync people’s CloudKit data to iCloud. Learn how you can reduce the amount of code in your app when you let the system handle scheduling for your sync operations. We’ll share how you can automatically benefit from enhanced performance as CloudKit evolves, explore testing for your sync implementation, and more. To get the most out of this session, you should be familiar with CloudKit and CKRecord types.
